title: Erasmus+ Projects
subtitle: Discover our Erasmus+ programmes and international mobility projects
noUpcomingProjects: No upcoming Erasmus+ projects at the moment.
hero_description: Discover Erasmus+, the European Solidarity Corps, and a universe of EU-funded opportunities designed to empower young people across the continent — and beyond.
flagship_title: Where do you want to go?
flagship_lead: The EU invests billions in helping young people study, volunteer, train, and work abroad. These are the main doors you can walk through.
flagship_erasmus_desc: The EU's flagship education and training programme. Whether you're a student, trainee, volunteer, youth worker, or educator, Erasmus+ funds exchanges, internships, and cooperation projects in over 150 countries.
flagship_esc_desc: Aged 18–30? Give up to 12 months of your time to projects that strengthen communities across Europe and beyond — all expenses covered, plus a monthly allowance and a Youthpass certificate.
flagship_eures_desc: The European Job Mobility Portal connects young job-seekers with employers across all EU/EEA countries. Targeted schemes (Your First EURES Job) even offer financial support for relocation.
flagship_digital_desc: From coding bootcamps to AI literacy, EU-funded programmes like Digital Europe and DiscoverEU support young people in acquiring the skills the modern economy demands.
opps_lead: The EU ecosystem of youth support goes well beyond one programme. Here are more funded pathways worth exploring.
opp_discovereu_desc: Turn 18 and travel Europe by train for free. An Interrail pass and a cultural adventure — all funded.
opp_europass_desc: Make your skills visible across borders. Free CV, language passport, and digital credential tools.
opp_marie_desc: Funding for early-stage researchers to pursue doctoral projects at leading European institutions.
opp_eit_desc: Entrepreneurship and innovation hubs for young changemakers across climate, health, and tech sectors.
opp_portal_desc: One gateway for all EU youth opportunities, news, grants, and volunteering calls across all member states.
opp_youth_action_desc: Country-level National Agencies administer local calls for projects, grants, and youth exchanges.
apply_lead: Most programmes follow a similar pathway. Here's how to go from curious to confirmed participant.
step_eligibility_desc: Age, nationality, and enrolment status vary by programme. Start on the European Youth Portal to find what fits you.
step_find_desc: Search open calls on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal or connect with your institution's Erasmus coordinator.
step_prepare_desc: A motivation letter, language proof, and a Learning Agreement are typically required. Use Europass to get started.
step_submit_desc: Submit via your institution or the national agency. Deadlines vary — check the programme calendar regularly.
step_go_desc: Once selected, document your experience. Many programmes require a post-activity report to release final funding.
elig_students_desc: Enrolled at an Erasmus Charter-holding institution. Minimum 1 year of study completed. Exchange for 3–12 months.
elig_vet_desc: Short-term (10–89 days) or long-term (90–365 days) traineeships abroad available via accredited VET providers.
elig_neet_title: Young People Not in Education or Employment
elig_neet_desc: Specific pathways under Key Action 1 and the European Solidarity Corps target NEETs with inclusive funding.
elig_workers_desc: Staff mobility grants fund training, job-shadowing, and teaching assignments for professionals working with youth.
elig_partners_desc: Many programmes extend to Western Balkans, Eastern Partnership countries, and beyond via International Credit Mobility.
cta_description: Millions of young Europeans have already changed their lives through EU programmes. Your turn.
